newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan July index of leading indicators at 77.8.
newsitem.headline: Japan July index of leading indicators at 77.8.

text.p: Japan's diffusion index of leading economic indicators stood at 77.8 on a scale of 100 in July, the Economic Planning Agency said on Tuesday.
A breakdown of the indices of economic indicators follows:
A figure for the index of leading economic indicators above the so-called "boom or bust" 50 mark is generally taken as suggesting the economy will expand in the coming months.
A figure for the leading index below 50 suggests the economy will contract in the coming months.
The coincident index measures current economic conditions, while the lagging index traces economic trends in the past few months.

The index of leading indicators was above the 50 mark for a fourth month in a row in July. The index of coincident indicators was above 50 for a second month in a row, while that of lagging indicators was below 50 for a fourth month.
The EPA said in a statement that the July indicators showed the economy was continuing to recover.
